title: Beyond English: Evaluating Automated Measurement of Moral Foundations in Non-English Discourse with a Chinese Case Study

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative and quantitative comparison of model predictions for Moral Foundations against ground-truth labels from native speakers to identify misalignments in culturally specific concepts (e.g., filial piety, political euphemisms, Catholic values) caused by English/WEIRD-centric training data.

Benchmarking and comparing the performance (F1 scores) of automated measurement approaches (machine translation, local lexicons, multilingual encoder models, LLMs) on cross-lingual Moral Foundation classification tasks using Chinese and Italian datasets versus English baselines.
